name: Parapsychologist Scholar Archetype
body:
Associated Skill Knowledge (psionics) (Int)

Basic Study Ability
Psionic Potential (Ex)

You gain Wild Talent UP as a bonus feat. If you take levels in a psionic class, you instead gain the Psionic Talent feat. In addition, you gain two psionic talents (0-level powers), chosen from any class list. You use Charisma as your manifesting statistic (for calculating DCs, and so on). You also gain a manifesting level equal to 1/2 your ranks in Knowledge (psionics) (minimum 1), which may grant you bonus power points and can be used to qualify for feats and other prerequisites.

Associated Technique
Resolve Technique (Ex)

You gain a +1 bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects originating from the target of this ability. At 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, this bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +5 at 20th level.

Advanced Study Abilities
Psionic Training I (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Charisma 11, Psionic Potential study ability, scholar level 2nd.

You gain 1 additional power point per manifester level. You also gain a 1st-level psionic power of your choice, chosen from any class list. When you attain 12 ranks in Knowledge (psionics), you gain one additional 1st-level power of your choice.

You use Charisma as your manifesting statistic.

Psionic Training II (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Charisma 12, Psionic Training I study ability, scholar level 6th.

You gain 1 additional power point per manifester level. You also gain a 2nd-level psionic power of your choice, chosen from any class list. When you attain 16 ranks in Knowledge (psionics), you gain one additional 2nd-level power of your choice.

Psionic Training III (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Charisma 13, Psionic Training II study ability, scholar level 10th.

You gain 2 additional power points per manifester level. You also gain a 3rd-level psionic power of your choice, chosen from any class list.

Psionic Training IV (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Charisma 14, Psionic Training III study ability, scholar level 14th.

You gain 2 additional power points per manifester level. You also gain a 4th-level psionic power of your choice, chosen from any class list.
